## Maintenance

AVENIQ provides structured post-launch support to keep web applications secure, up to date, and operating at peak performance:

- **Software Security Patches**: Regular updates of npm dependency packages, security libraries, and framework versions.
- **Uptime & Performance Monitoring**: Automated monitoring tools ensuring 99.9% uptime and rapid notification of any technical anomalies.
- **Content & Feature Enhancements**: Ongoing allocation of developer hours for minor visual tweaks, content updates, and new component creation.
- **Database & Asset Backups**: Automated daily and weekly backups of database stores and uploaded media files.
